body:
## Linked Issue

Refs #1895

Related #2295. Original functional issues remain open and incomplete.

## Scope Summary

Independent eight-input SOURCE combination on exact #4385 `b302f58a9aaee9f2399d9274157a478f3c2f78fb`, using actual clean FsusUI981 `2e0e059f193407170d8e23bcc40d59f1af3291f6` local source. Inputs are exactly #4409 `1c9b6ed9533c09c4a9b692dd998d6f21a0c06c09`, #4411 `90b0f1bee407b0d08947b3ddb7d835bc20b83570`, #4413 `9caae973dc9796e2ba7e82a4bb2ee76496365e27`, #4414 `3da8ed3bbeda41e84309659373e4b52be4d506db`, #4415 `10eafa66ee637053ce9c5e3c28c5a677037e19e8`, #4417 `d806320823219172c506a8f49fbcde4bd5844a95`, #4418 `4d4866394de57e4ca961aef0cb663934f14ddc36`, #4419 `d37175a869b375aff06e9761afdcf82c2168bbe9`.

Exact union: 741 disjoint paths, eight modified production Vue files and 733 original engineering-evidence additions. Verify every input Git blob/mode/base preimage; retain every original WIP, log, failure, patch and historical context unchanged. All 7,956 base entries outside the union remain exact. No donor history is replayed. This combination requires independent receiving SOURCE review; input acceptance does not accept the new union.

Production scope: ArticleWriteEditor surface buttons; ArticleCommentTreeNode row controls; LocaleSelector public Button/ref composition; ArticleWriteOutlineRail launcher/rendered controls/public refs; ArticleRevisionPanel revision rows; ArticleCommentsVirtualList root expansion; SecuritySimulator presets; SecurityDashboardWorkbench refresh. Only these exact accepted postimages are admitted. No additional API/business/security/permission/host/transport/cancellation/settlement owner is changed.

Duplicate searches and exact remote #4420 file list were inspected. #4420 is the separate three-input 25-production-file combination at `4207252d2a15c0029f163b771a44cbfd01560c4d`; production overlap is zero. Neither its tree nor history is included here.

- [x] Other: compiler-only SFC parse/script AST/template/scoped-style transforms, base and candidate eight files, exit 0; generated product code never evaluated and no product CSS emitted. Exact input blob/mode/preimage, protected base and source/aggregate Git diff checks recorded separately.

Fresh raw results on the same worktree/dependencies and actual UI981 source:

| Original check | Base | Candidate | Raw comparison |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Full local application, 771 root files | FAIL2 / 29 diagnostics | FAIL2 / 29 | Byte-identical |
| Original node configuration | FAIL2 / TS7016 | FAIL2 / TS7016 | Byte-identical |
| Full lint, strict-full, supplemental strict-owned | FAIL1 / configured ESLint and Stylelint absent | FAIL1 / same | Byte-identical; lint diagnostic coverage unavailable |
| FsusUI / binary boundaries | FAIL1 / 20; FAIL1 / 6 | Same | Byte-identical |
| Code intent / lifecycle / authoritative docs | FAIL1 / 2 errors; FAIL1 / 7 lines; FAIL1 / 41 lines | Same | Byte-identical |
| Eight SFC compiler-only transforms | PASS0 | PASS0 | No product evaluation |
| Production whitespace / exact input-union aggregate | PASS0 / PASS0 | PASS0 / FAIL2 | Original raw evidence whitespace retained |

Complete original outputs are retained without filtering, normalization or deduplication. Packaged full-tree whitespace remains FAIL2, including copied diagnostic whitespace. The static failures are unresolved.

## Rollout / Rollback

- Rollout: private repository draft and ordinary SOURCE WIP only, using the fixed exact common base and UI981 source alias.
- Rollback: omit/revert this combination's exact 741-path union and its own ordinary evidence/WIP to the common base; original input branches are untouched and no live state changed.
- Deferred work: independent review of this exact eight-input composition, unresolved complete-static failures, genuine UI981 product CSS output and all held runtime/consumer/qualification work.
- Known limitations: current lint cannot run its configured tools; original full-app and boundary/intent/docs failures persist. Historical missing raw logs and large-body independent-read gaps remain UNVERIFIED. No current run/hash/local copy resolves those historical gaps. Original #4336 aggregate FAIL and native resource-loan/worker shutdown/recovery/disposed-restore ACK gaps persist. Missing/skipped remote checks are not passes.

## Notes For Reviewers

Current handoff: `artifacts/article-editor/issue-2295-eight-input-common-ui981.json`. Current raw map: `artifacts/article-editor/eight-input-common-ui981-static/delivery-map.json`; exact source manifest, protected-base proof, authority/source identity, duplicate checks and original command records are adjacent ordinary engineering evidence. All 741 input entries retain original bytes/modes, including archived helper/setup/install scripts as data only. None of those scripts is executed. Old WIPs describe their original single-leaf boundaries and exclusions; this new WIP alone describes the new union.

Every historical failure remains tied to its original input/environment. This includes original application29/node failures, 83,667-line style failures, missing-tool attempts, whitespace/metadata/ancestry failures and any earlier counts from different UI inputs. Historical donor temp logs remain unavailable where originally recorded. #4415 explicitly retained four 11,861,610-byte inherited style bodies with a transport/materialization gap; #4419 also records sparse large-body limits. Local Git/blob/hash integrity or materialization here does not establish independent reading of those historical large bodies. No fabricated raw logs, exits, pass labels or replacement evidence.

Both design Skills and current public Button/consumer/source contracts apply; their exact hashes are ordinary context only. No formal frozen classification/adjudication/acceptance/qualification receipt, catalog, fixture, baseline, registry or authority is created or refreshed. Reviewed checklist items describe source-scope applicability: public wire/API/DTO/AEDS/database/security policy/performance/generated/external naming/format-only/blame changes are inapplicable. Existing public API and product contracts need no semantic update; the new WIP records composition and limitations. Formatter fields are none because this is no format migration. The linter entry was invoked and failed, not passed.

All runtime/tests/help/list/discovery/collection/setup/product/helper/parser-module behavior evaluation/browser/native/worker/kernel/DB/security/privacy/receipt/race/backuprestore/IME/frozen/qualification work remains HOLD/UNRUN. No product build, install, bootstrap, replacement behavioral harness, credential/security permission change, denied-action restart or authority refresh. Only original static tooling and compiler parsing/transformation execute. Task commits carry `[skip ci]` to preserve execution HOLD; no workflow is manually dispatched or rerun. No Ready, merge, close, release or package publication.
